_readme: Level 2 objectives (same format as Level_01/objectives.json; see its _readme and _triggers).
The office is open from the start: no plaza profiles and no side quest before the case.
event:CaseFolderRetrieved is raised when the player takes Rosa's folder out of the market-client drawer (cabinet retrieval, ticket T02).
state:ReviewDocumentsState: the case folder was opened at the desk the first time, by tap or by drag.
event:FindingRecorded: the Findings page has a concern, a related record and a reason (T03).
event:PreliminaryHoldStamped: a supported initial Not Ready stamp was recorded (T03).
event:RosaRecordsCollected: Rosa's conversation finished and she handed over records D1-D6 (T04).
event:MarketDeskOpened: the player sat at the records desk beside the stall the first time (T04).
Later Level 2 tickets add steps for the preliminary finding, Rosa's stall, Mark the Money!, reconciliation and the final stamp.
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.

steps.text: Get Rosa's folder from the market-client drawer in the file storage room.
Sit at your desk and drag Rosa's folder from your folder icon onto the desk to open it.
On the Findings page, record your concern: a summary line, the related record and a reason.
Stamp the initial review on Rosa's folder with the stamps on your desk.
Visit Aling Rosa at Stall 04 near the plaza and talk to her.
Sit at the records desk beside Rosa's stall.
Submit the case folder to the Auditor in his office.
